name: Kairnial
positioning: Construction document control and site quality for large French projects, with the traceability an owner needs at handover.
description: Kairnial is a collaborative platform for construction and asset lifecycle: controlled document management with versioning and approval circuits, site quality and snagging, safety and compliance records, BIM model consultation, and structured handover packages.
real_estate_use: On a large French project the governing risk is documentary: which version of a plan was approved, who validated it, and what evidence exists that a reserve was lifted. Kairnial organises that chain — the visa circuit, the dated observation, the signed lift — so the handover file is defensible and the operator inherits usable data rather than a hard drive.
features: Controlled document management with visa and approval circuits
Site observations, snagging and reserve lifting with evidence
BIM model consultation linked to documents

use_cases.job: Keep a defensible approval and reserve-lifting record across a large project
Receive a structured handover file that operations can actually use
